searchText: Some comments very late and tired and without my glasses to type on a cell. Thanks for writing this. I think the target may be small, the 128 was chosen for before the fork. We can have a target of 1K post fork I think, or even larger. I like the inhibitor to stop taking in the next fork I would prefer if there aren't calls to external contracts and they are inlined instead, but I'll take any contract/EL dev opinion over mine
